race.comment: MANPOWER (6) led and looked headed for a second straight win only to be nailed on the line by an in-form sprinter last start over 1200m at Eagle Farm. Cherry ripe after three runs back and will prove tough to catch coming back slightly in trip. SPIETHTACULAR (15) is back after a 23-week spell. Comes to hand quickly and a nice recent trial win is a positive sign. Stablemate PETIT ARTISTE (16) is also capable of a bright run while fresh. CORRUPTED (11) ended last campaign with a good win at Eagle Farm and her latest trial was very solid at this track. Won't mind getting her toe in and she can pick up from where she left off.
